nights.title: Manuş Baba
nights.name: Manuş Baba
nights.extract: Mustafa Özkan, better known by his stage name Manuş Baba, is a Turkish pop and arabesque singer. He studied at the Tarsus Turgut İçgören primary school in Tarsus. His family later moved from Diyarbakir to Antalya, due to his father's job as a seasonal worker in Antalya. He studied at Antalya Gazi High School and Akdeniz University. He started his music career with his band Güneşe Yolculuk in 2010. He also has had a number of hit albums in Turkey, including Bu Havada Gidilmez, Dönersen Islık Çal and İki Gözümün Çiçeği.

facts: Seine Familie zog später von Diyarbakir nach Antalya, weil sein Vater dort als Saisonarbeiter tätig war.
Er hatte in der Türkei mehrere erfolgreiche Alben, darunter Bu Havada Gidilmez, Dönersen Islık Çal und İki Gözümün Çiçeği.

Türkiye'de Bu Havada Gidilmez, Dönersen Islık Çal ve İki Gözümün Çiçeği gibi birçok hit albümü de oldu.

nights.title: Simge
nights.name: Simge

nights.title: Candan Erçetin - Doğu Batı Senfonisi - Rengahenk Konser
nights.name: Candan Erçetin
nights.extract: Candan Erçetin is a Turkish singer-songwriter. Over the twenty five years of her singing career, she has been recognized for preparing and singing songs about human life. Despite the fact that she made her albums without much publicity, her work influenced other artists. Erçetin has released many music videos with different themes. Because her family originate from the Balkans, she has often used elements of Balkan music in her songs and works. In addition to Turkish, she has written songs in French and Greek.

en.who: Candan Erçetin is a Turkish singer-songwriter. Over the twenty five years of her singing career, she has been recognized for preparing and singing songs about human life.

de.who: Candan Erçetin ist eine türkische Singer-Songwriterin. In ihren fünfundzwanzig Jahren als Sängerin wurde sie für ihre Lieder über das menschliche Leben geschätzt.
facts: Da ihre Familie vom Balkan stammt, verwendet sie in ihren Liedern und Werken häufig Elemente der Balkanmusik.

facts: Ailesi Balkanlardan geldiği için şarkılarında ve eserlerinde sıkça Balkan müziğinin unsurlarını kullandı.

nights.title: Yeni Türkü
nights.name: Yeni Türkü
nights.extract: Yeni Türkü is a Turkish band. The group has held concerts and has recorded a number of albums since forming in 1978. Their musical style is characterized by a combination of traditional Turkish and modern musical instruments, including the oud, baglama, kemenche, qanun and guitar. Their music reflects influences of music from around the world. All group members have changed several times throughout the years, with the exception of the lead singer Derya Köroğlu. After the coup of September 12, 1980, the album Buğdayın Türküsü, composed of poems by names such as Nazım Hikmet, was banned. For this reason, Yeni Türkü's career was interrupted for a short time.

en.who: Yeni Türkü is a Turkish band that has held concerts and recorded a number of albums since forming in 1978. Its style combines traditional and modern instruments from Turkey and beyond.
facts: Their musical style is characterized by a combination of traditional Turkish and modern musical instruments, including the oud, baglama, kemenche, qanun and guitar.
After the coup of September 12, 1980, the album Buğdayın Türküsü, composed of poems by names such as Nazım Hikmet, was banned.

de.who: Yeni Türkü ist eine türkische Band, die seit ihrer Gründung 1978 Konzerte gegeben und mehrere Alben aufgenommen hat. Ihr Stil verbindet traditionelle und moderne Instrumente.

tr.who: Yeni Türkü, 1978'de kurulmuş bir Türk grubudur. Kuruluşundan bu yana konserler vermiş ve çok sayıda albüm kaydetmiştir.
facts: Müzik tarzı; ud, bağlama, kemençe, kanun ve gitar dahil geleneksel Türk ve modern müzik aletlerinin bir birleşiminden oluşur.
12 Eylül 1980 darbesinin ardından, Nazım Hikmet gibi isimlerin şiirlerinden oluşan Buğdayın Türküsü albümü yasaklandı.

nights.title: Jakuzi
nights.name: Jakuzi
nights.extract: Jakuzi is a Turkish synthpop band, formed in Istanbul in 2015. The band consists of Kutay Soyocak, Can Kalyoncu, Meriç Erseçgen and Ahmetcan Gökçeer. Kutay Soyocak and Taner Yücel formed the project to move away from their previous punk-oriented music projects. The duo rose to prominence in Istanbul's underground music scene after the release of their debut album Fantezi Müzik. Originally released in 2016 through Domuz Records, it was reissued by City Slang on 24 March 2017.

en.who: Jakuzi is a Turkish synthpop band, formed in Istanbul in 2015. The band consists of Kutay Soyocak, Can Kalyoncu, Meriç Erseçgen and Ahmetcan Gökçeer.
facts: The duo rose to prominence in Istanbul's underground music scene after the release of their debut album Fantezi Müzik.

facts: Das Duo wurde in der Untergrundszene Istanbuls bekannt, nachdem das Debütalbum Fantezi Müzik erschienen war.

facts: İkili, ilk albümleri Fantezi Müzik'in yayımlanmasının ardından İstanbul'un yeraltı müzik sahnesinde öne çıktı.
